feed.title: NPR Topics: Politics
feed.subtitle: NPR's expanded coverage of U.S. and world politics, the latest news from Congress and the White House and elections.

entry.title: Long agenda, short meeting: Trump and Xi meet
entry.summary: All Things Considered host Mary Louise Kelly talks with White House correspondent Emily Feng about the Trump/Xi summit.

entry.title: In one of their last votes before November, Senate GOP blocks effort to end Iran war
entry.summary: The vote on a war powers resolution introduced by Democrats came at a moment when some Republicans have begun to distance themselves from President Trump over the ongoing conflict.

entry.title: What's at stake during the meeting between Trump and Xi
entry.summary: What can we expect from the Trump-Xi summit? NPR's A Martinez asks Daniel Kritenbrink, an assistant Secretary of State for East Asian and Pacific affairs in the Biden administration.

entry.title: Chinese leader Xi Jinping arrives in U.S. for first state visit in 11 years
entry.summary: Chinese leader Xi Jinping arrived in the United States on Wednesday evening for his first state visit in 11 years.

entry.title: Warren demands Trump officials explain removing a ban on interference in census data
entry.summary: Democratic Sen. Elizabeth Warren asked Trump officials to explain why the Census Bureau's parent agency cut a ban on political interference from its scientific integrity policy, as NPR first reported.

entry.title: Could the White House try its press ban again? A press freedom expert explains
entry.summary: A federal judge's ruling restored CNN, MS Now and Politico's access to the White House. Gabe Rottman says better procedure alone may not resolve the broader First Amendment fight.

entry.title: Journalists for CNN, MS NOW and Politico return to the White House upon judge's orders
entry.summary: A federal judge ordered the Trump administration on Thursday to temporarily restore access to CNN, MS NOW and Politico, after they were banned from covering White House events by President Trump.

entry.title: Results are in from the newest NPR/PBS News/Marist poll
entry.summary: People say they are more likely to choose a Democrat to represent them in Congress, and feel Democrats would be better at tackling top issues like the economy and foreign policy.

entry.title: Trump and Xi meet at moment of global consequence
entry.summary: It is the second time the leaders are meeting this year after the Beijing summit in May.

entry.title: From cybersecurity to AI to Taiwan, what's at stake in Trump's summit with Xi
entry.summary: As President Trump and China's President Xi prepare to meet, Rush Doshi of the Council on Foreign Relations explains the current state of U.S.-China relations and what to expect from this summit.
